note: Alberta Parks campground in jack pine forest on Moose Lake, about 13 km NW of Bonnyville (Hwy 41, Hwy 660, then 1 km south). Two loops set back from the lake; a sandy beach, boat launch, pier, fish cleaning and playground nearby. The taps are not drinkable: bring water, or fill tanks at Franchere Bay PRA. Blue-green algae and fecal-bacteria advisories were posted for the lake in August 2026. --Claude
